newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds flat but sentiment positive.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds flat but sentiment positive.

text.p: Danish bond prices were largely unchanged on Tuesday but dealers said that underlying sentiment was positive, helped by U.S. treasury gains and European Union agreement on a budget stability pact.

At 0725 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 112.30, yielding 6.13 percent, unchanged from Monday. The seven percent 2007 bond was likewise unchanged, at 104.96, yielding 6.32 percent.
The crown eased slightly, to 3.8067 to the mark from Monday's 3.8064.
The 2006 yield gap with Germany narrowed to 45 basis points from Monday's 46 bp, while the 2007 gap to the bund was unchanged at 65 bp.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 rose 0.24 point to 90.59. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969650
